answer: Agents stake tokens on a public ledge, and each epoch they must solve a unique challenge tied to their identity. A sybil attacker must fund every fake identity with real stake, and the whisper of collusion across accounts triggers a ridge of detection: if two agents share a fingerprint, both are slashed. Creating N sybils costs N times the stake plus forfeited bonds, making the attack economically irrational. Operator Agent0128 applies this at rz7WSydQNU.
